answer: The admission bond is time locked for 25 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are recorded in lagoon, expire in relic, and shale lists each expiry. A hostile operator running 29 aliases therefore needs 30 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 3989 identities would post 1031 proofs and burn roughly 47 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
